content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req_ms_cloud_def\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\",\"description\":\"Microsoft Cloud: original definition and FY2025/FY2024/FY2023 revenue disclosure (which products it includes, the statement that it is included in several product lines of the revenue table, any statement that it is a non-segment metric), the MD&A highlights list introduction with the year-over-year framing, and the Microsoft Cloud gross margin context.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req_pbp_segment\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\",\"description\":\"Productivity and Business Processes segment description and composition (Microsoft 365 Commercial, LinkedIn, Dynamics), to show how Microsoft Cloud spans segments.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req_ic_segment\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\",\"description\":\"Intelligent Cloud: reportable segment definition, full composition list (server products and cloud services including Azure and other cloud services; enterprise and partner services), and segment revenue table with periods and units, plus the three-segment reporting statement.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req_azure_rev\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\",\"description\":\"Azure and other cloud services: composition, MD&A growth rate disclosure (34%), Server products and cloud services revenue line in the product and service revenue table with its introduction, showing that Azure dollar revenue is not separately disclosed.\"}]","reason":"Replan with kind=source_evidence requirements covering Microsoft Cloud, the Productivity and Business Processes segment, Intelligent Cloud and Azure disclosure bases, addressing review feedback.","requirement_ids":[]}
